you_should_know.title: Vance Boelter claims he was trying to make citizen's arrest during lawmaker shootings
you_should_know.summary: A strange start today in the state case against a political assassin. That includes a jail house blog, a "Fight Club" reference, and this stunning new defense. Vance Boelter, the man charged in the 2025 attacks on two Minnesota lawmakers and their spouses, now claims he was trying to make a citizen's arrest when he carried out the attacks. It's a claim prosecutors call "delusional." Jason Rantala was in court today.
